title: Template spoke skills were 100% stale — all 26 files out of sync with framework source
signal: templates/spoke/skills/ was completely out of sync with templates/commands/. Every single skill file (26 of 26) was stale. New spokes created from the template would get outdated protocol files. Manual sync fixed it, but there is no automated mechanism to prevent drift.
rationale: Any new spoke bootstrapped from the template would have been running stale wakeup, closeout, and lug advisor protocols. This is a silent correctness failure — the spoke would appear to work but follow outdated rules. Needs an automated sync step (closeout hook or pre-commit check).
